description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, demonstrating how to create notifications with custom RemoteViews layouts, including expanded views, and handling notification click actions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that demonstrates creating and displaying custom notifications with expanded views.
